title: A Lean 4 Formalization of Interpreting Lambda Calculus in Domain-Valued Random Variables (CSL 2026)
description: Machine-checked Lean 4 formalization scaffold for Furber, Mardare, Panangaden, and Scott's 2026 paper Interpreting Lambda Calculus in Domain-Valued Random Variables (LIPIcs, CSL 2026). The paper's authors were not contacted and did not participate in, review, or endorse this formalization. Primary readable artifact: arxiv.pdf (when published). Source repository: https://github.com/catskillsresearch/scott2026.
notes: Software and Lean sources are Apache-2.0 (see LICENSE). The source PDF in sources/ is not Apache-2.0 (see NOTICE). Readable paper PDF is arxiv.pdf in this deposit when present. Prepared with LLM assistance; all Lean proofs are machine-checked.
